title: The Impact of Large Language Models on K-12 Education in Rural India: A Thematic Analysis of Student Volunteer’s Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of semi-structured interviews with volunteer teachers to identify the limitations of AI tools that predominantly operate in English or Hindi, failing to support the regional language needs of rural students.

Qualitative evaluation through educator interviews to assess how AI models trained on urban-centric or Western datasets result in content mismatches and fail to reflect the socio-cultural realities of rural Indian classrooms.

Thematic analysis of interview data to evaluate how the cost, lack of digital access, and infrastructural deficits associated with AI tools disproportionately disadvantage rural, low-income students and reinforce the digital divide.
